definitions.explanation: Describes being tightly packed or crammed together with little or no space.
Describes the action of squeezing or pressing something firmly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{満員電車|まんいんでんしゃ}→満員電車：08350_manindensha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ぎゅうぎゅう⟦{詰|づ}め→詰める：02078_tsumeru⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: It was packed tight on the crowded train.

examples.japanese: ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ぎゅうぎゅう⟦{押|お}し{込|こ}んだ→押し込む：04237_oshikomu⟧。
examples.english: I crammed the luggage in tightly.

examples.japanese: ⟦スーツケース→スーツケース：01781_suutsukeesu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぎゅうぎゅう⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{閉|し}まらない→閉まる：00754_shimaru⟧。
examples.english: The suitcase is so packed it won't close.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}→冷蔵庫：01046_reizouko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぎゅうぎゅう⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{入|はい}らない→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: The fridge is so packed that nothing else fits.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ぎゅうぎゅう⟦{抱|だ}きしめた→抱きしめる：06044_dakishimeru⟧。
examples.english: I squeezed my child tightly in a hug.

examples.japanese: ぎゅうぎゅう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{握|にぎ}りすぎて→握る：02383_nigiru⟧、⟦{中身|なかみ}→中身：01483_nakami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦つぶれて→潰れる：04249_tsubureru⟧⟦しまった→てしまう：03102_teshimau⟧。
examples.english: I squeezed it so tightly that the contents got crushed.

notes:
USAGE:
ぎゅうぎゅう describes tight compression or packing. It conveys a sense of discomfort or strain from being squeezed.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ぎゅうぎゅう⟦{詰|づ}め→詰める：02078_tsumeru⟧: packed tight, crammed
- ぎゅうぎゅう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{押|お}し{込|こ}む→押し込む：04237_oshikomu⟧: to cram in tightly
- ぎゅうぎゅう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{詰|つ}まる→詰まる：02079_tsumaru⟧: to be tightly packed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ぎゅっと→ぎゅっと：05355_gyutto⟧: (single action) tightly, firmly
- ⟦ぱんぱん→ぱんぱん：29037_panpan⟧: stretched full, about to burst
- ⟦{満杯|まんぱい}→満杯：18053_manpai⟧: completely full
